long_biography.plain_text:
CareerWork$ carried Les Biller’s banking experience into workforce training for people excluded from conventional hiring pipelines. Launched as BankWork$ in 2006, it paired free training with access to entry-level roles and later expanded into health-care administration and wider job-readiness programmes. The initiative became an independent charity before joining the Washington Bankers Association in 2024.

Biller and his wife, Sheri, built their foundation around active partnership rather than grant-making alone. Its other signature work promotes earlier, more equitable supportive cancer care, including resource centres and professional training at City of Hope. Drawing on his experience managing large financial organisations and serving on corporate boards, Biller has remained involved as the foundation’s co-founder.
